decision: Plan 2026-10-28-epl-pick-a-team.md Task 6; D-46 logo rule extended to Premier League crests (spec section 8)
scope: Premier League club crests used only to identify each club next to its name. Trademarks of their owners; not licensed; no endorsement. Self-hosted downscaled copies of ESPN CDN images for the club list in shared/epl-clubs.mjs (see docs/TEAM_LOGO_SOURCES.md#premier-league-crests).

BOU.modifications: Downscaled only (Pillow LANCZOS, aspect and alpha kept); no recolor, no crop.
BOU.usage: Small club-identification crests shown next to the club name in Pick a Team and EPL data displays only; no endorsement or app-brand use.
